text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa got injured during 
training, so I brought her to the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
An injury like this doesn't bother El in 
the slightest, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine, so Trainer-san, please 
prepare for after my injury heals, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's why, Trainer-san! El is totally 
fine, see!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So, I should hurry over to the Trainer's 
Room... Wait, there you—ouch!
choice_data_list: You're clearly pushing yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Rather than impossible, it's more like... 
um...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Um, this happened because El let her guard 
down, so...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I didn't have enough fighting 
spirit.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Um, this happened because El let her guard 
down, so...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I didn't have enough fighting 
spirit.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not! El is the one at fault here, 
desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Just because El was weak...! El, El is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nwooooh!! I have to become stronger! El 
wants to get much, much stronger!
choice_data_list:
Let's make sure you fully recover before 
that.

Let's make sure you fully recover before 
that.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Sí! Sorry for the trouble, yeees!

With a renewed spirit, El Condor Pasa took 
a proper rest and fully recovered from her 
injury.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Reflect, introspect, El must deeply 
correct...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Papa is definitely going to be mad at me 
for this, desu...
choice_data_list: Let's be more careful next time.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. From now on, I'll need to train 
much, much more carefully, yes..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Not enough fighting spirit... you say?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Gnnngh! How shameful for the great El 
Condor Pasa to do such a thing...!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí, se puede! El knows she can do better 
than this, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm fully pumped up! Trainer! 
Expect great things from El from now on, 
desu!

True to her declaration, she healed her 
injury in a few days and handled her 
training even better than before.
